decisions.Kwic: 唯是休歇到一念不生處，則便透脫，不墮情塵，不居意想

Decision.AttributionNote: Essentials of Chan Master Foguo Keqin (佛果克勤禪師心要). The complete instruction is Yuanwu Keqin's own direct address: Yuanwu says that resting until not one thought arises brings release from sense-dust and conceptual imagining. No embedded speaker owns the stored line.

Decision.AttributionNote: Essentials of Chan Master Foguo Keqin (佛果克勤禪師心要), immediately before the instruction to State Grandmother Zhang. Yuanwu Keqin is the exact speaker who describes functioning throughout the twelve hours without self and other, love and hate, gain and loss, coming and going, and quotes the saying about natural functioning.
